# Search results for onnxruntime coreml provider fallback

- [Apple CoreML EP notes](https://example.test/coreml-notes): CoreML fails closed on unsupported ops; ORT falls back to the CPU EP for those nodes.
- [Provider ordering guidance](https://example.test/provider-order): List CoreML before CPU so unsupported ops still run rather than erroring out.
